name: ops
description: Kubernetes day-2 operations: manifests are verified offline; live changes go through the human-approved rollout skill, never through harness run.

rubric.functionality: The manifests express the desired state the contract names (image, replicas, resources, config) and nothing else changes.
rubric.quality: Labels and selectors consistent, resource requests and limits set, no duplicated config that should be shared.
rubric.security: RBAC least privilege, NetworkPolicy for new workloads, Pod Security restricted (non-root, read-only root filesystem, no privilege escalation), no secrets in plain manifests.
rubric.errors: Readiness and liveness probes defined; a rollback path (previous image tag or revision) exists for every change that will reach a live cluster.
rubric.tests: Offline validation passes. Live verification (rollout status, probes, smoke checks) belongs to the rollout skill and is not scored here.
